deck.en: A cobalt shell with black trousers and an ear-covering beanie.
deck.de: Eine kobaltblaue Jacke mit schwarzer Hose und Mütze über den Ohren.

intro.ko: 비니가 눈썹 쪽으로 내려오면 잠깐 멈춰 정리합니다. 코발트 셸을 중심으로 나머지는 어둡게 맞추고, 어깨와 손등의 반사 디테일을 가리지 않게 입으세요.
intro.en: Pause to readjust when the beanie slips toward the eyebrows. Let the cobalt shell lead the palette, keep the rest dark, and leave the shoulder and glove reflections visible.
intro.de: Kurz anhalten, wenn die Mütze zu den Augenbrauen rutscht. Die kobaltblaue Jacke gibt den Farbton vor, der Rest bleibt dunkel. Reflexdetails an Schultern und Handschuhen frei lassen.

tip.ko: 젖은 노면에서는 속도를 낮추고, 달린 뒤에는 마른 옷으로 갈아입으세요. 반사 디테일만으로 야간 시야가 확보되는 것은 아니므로 밝은 길을 선택하세요.
tip.en: Slow down on wet surfaces and change into dry clothes after the run. Reflective details alone do not ensure visibility; choose a well-lit route.
tip.de: Auf nassem Untergrund langsamer laufen und danach trockene Kleidung anziehen. Reflexdetails allein sichern keine Sichtbarkeit; eine gut beleuchtete Strecke wählen.

pull.ko: 몸이 데워지는 속도에 맞춰, 한 겹씩 조절하세요.
pull.en: Adjust each layer as your body warms up.
pull.de: Die Schichten anpassen, während der Körper warm wird.

copy.appPull: ADJUST EACH LAYER AS YOUR BODY WARMS UP.

howToWear.en: Wear over a thin warm base layer and adjust the zip for ventilation. Keep the hood clear of your sightline and remove the damp shell after the run.
